author: NicodemusArcleon
body: I have 2 celestial axes on my GSA. One I use for summoning for endless full of summon stat %,  and the other is full of ward recovery and one adornment for ward damage -> HP/MP.

author: Fluid_Pie_9428
body:
Preferably Cele Axe, this will be your main weapon most of the time (my personal choice with the augments is: 3x Prom feet and 2x Themis heart **HOWEVER** the mnemosine augment has a tad more base ward but no additional bonuses so you could look into these)

Then there are some rare cases where you'd want Cele Quarterstaff (endless setup mainly but it can be replaced by a Skyshard Quarterstaff since it's only 1% summon stat difference)

And probably that's it for GSA, for base GS you'd want Cele staff in case you'd want to do Ultima raiding.... Pretty much all the celestial weaponry you'd need

Can go with the 2h celestial staff in case you'd want to revive stuff in endless (whole 1 more Oceanus lung more than one handed)
